title: The Dragon's Riddle
text: An old dragon blocks the pass, too tired to fight, its scales gone grey at the edges like ash on a dying fire. One eye opens, gold and enormous. It will let you through, it rumbles, for the answer to a riddle. It has eaten everyone who got it wrong.

options.label: The cleverest answers the dragon's riddle.

outcomes.text: Right. The dragon laughs, a rumble like a landslide, and gives you a scale for luck.
Wrong. It is not too tired after all.

options.label: The shrewdest asks it a riddle back.

outcomes.text: It thinks for an hour, smoke curling, and lets you pass while it thinks.
A long, cold way round, with the dragon's eye on your backs.
